items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: he thought Emmett Hardy was better than Dix

ctx.x: Yeah. But he, you know, he said that he knew and he'd played with people like the Halfway House Orchestra, New Orleans Jazz Club. And that he thought Emmett Hardy was better than Dix. And that he'd made at least one side privately. But then all sorts of other people have said the same sort of thing.

Yeah. Well, it's nice to have confirmation. Instead of something, say, coming from my faith all along. And also I found a napkin signed by some people from the Italian Village at 115 Columbus Avenue, San Francisco.
